subject: Annual committed spend — billing windows, collection checkpoints, and VAT country owners
messages:
From: Melanie S. <melanie.s@bluebay-analytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun.finance@brightlane.com>, BlueBay Billing <billing@bluebay-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Annual prepay billing windows & VAT evidence — need to confirm ops handoffs

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're aligning our finance ops and need a clear, punchy schedule for the annual prepay invoicing and the subsequent monthly drawdown windows so we can map to our treasury windows. Two specific asks from our side:

- A single-sheet schedule that shows invoice dates, due dates, and the allowed drawdown windows (UTC) for the year.
- A short list of country VAT evidence owners at Redwood (who we should contact for Germany / France / UK).

Can you also confirm whether Redwood can route invoices with PO numbers on them and if wire instructions will change depending on region? Arjun from Brightlane is helping us with payment rails.

Appreciate a one-pager or spreadsheet we can attach to our AP team. If possible we need this by end of next week — our tax team is starting the VAT reconciliation on 31 July.

Best,
Melanie
CFO (interim)
BlueBay Analytics

--
Attachment: BlueBay-VAT-Evidence-Request.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Melanie S. <melanie.s@bluebay-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.finance@brightlane.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2028 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Annual prepay billing windows & VAT evidence — need to confirm ops handoffs

Melanie — thanks, noted.

High level plan (quick):
1) I'll share a single-sheet invoice governance schedule (attached) that includes invoice issue dates, net terms, and the monthly drawdown windows we use for committed spend.
2) Wire / remit routing: Hosted invoices are billed to our EUR lockbox by default for EU customers. We will include PO numbers on the invoice PDF if provided at purchase. If BlueBay needs wires to go to a local bank for regulatory reasons we can route per-region; we'll confirm routing once we have the PO and legal remit instructions.
3) VAT / country owner: Kimberly will be the EU VAT owner for Germany & France; Vivek will own UK & ROW VAT escalations. I'll include contact emails on the schedule.

Deliverables I attached: RB-Invoice-Governance-Schedule-v1.xlsx (master schedule) and a short checklist for what your AP team should attach to each payment (PO, invoice pdf, remittance advice).

Action items:
- Melanie / Arjun: confirm if BlueBay will provide a single PO series (recommended) or per-country POs.
- Kimberly: can you confirm the VAT evidence packet we expect (invoice + signed PO + certificate) so I can list it specifically?
- Vivek: adding you for any UK VAT notes (reverse charge applicability).

I can hop on a 30-minute sync later this week to run through wiring and the DocuSign invoice authorization we use.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Melanie S. <melanie.s@bluebay-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2028 12:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Annual prepay billing windows & VAT evidence — need to confirm ops handoffs

Neha / Melanie — quick clarifying note on VAT evidence.

For DE / FR we require:
- Invoice (PDF) with our VAT registration number and your company VAT number
- Signed PO (scanned PDF) referencing the invoice number
- A country-specific certificate where required (e.g., for certain French intracommunity transactions)

If the transaction is treated under reverse charge, please include the legal basis in the invoice text. I will prepare a one-paragraph template line BlueBay can paste on invoices to satisfy our downstream auditors.

If BlueBay will centralize payments through a single PO, that simplifies our ledger tagging; if you use country-level POs we'll attach country tags and that may change the remittance routing.

Happy to join the sync if you want me to run through the evidence file examples.

Kimberly Park
Senior Tax Manager — Billing & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Melanie S. <melanie.s@bluebay-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2028 13:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Annual prepay billing windows & VAT evidence — need to confirm ops handoffs

Adding a couple operational points from Dedicated/Dedicated Private flows:
- Drawdown windows: Our standard is to allow draws starting 48 hours after invoice issuance to allow for bank settlement and PO validation. For high-frequency drawdowns (weekly), we can set a daily window with a 4-hour settlement pre-window. The master schedule lists the default windows but we can override per-account.
- Ledger & accounting: Please ensure BlueBay includes the deal id (DB-2027-042) on all remittance advices so Marissa can auto-match in the ledger.
- DocuSign: We use a DocuSign workflow for initial invoice authorization only for annual commitments over $250k; otherwise electronic invoice acceptance via HubSpot suffice.

Marissa — pls confirm the ledger tag schema (I think it's BBY-YYYY-MM).

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Ops, EU
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Melanie S. <melanie.s@bluebay-analytics.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.finance@brightlane.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2028 15:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Annual prepay billing windows & VAT evidence — need to confirm ops handoffs

Thanks all — rapid status update: I've added a small column set on the schedule for PO series + ledger tag and included a sample remittance advice template. Key notes:

- If BlueBay supplies a single PO series, we'll tag all invoices as BBY-2028-ANNUAL and set monthly drawdown windows on the sheet.
- If separate country POs are used, the ledger tags will include country suffix (e.g., BBY-DE-2028-01) and payment routing may require a local wire for DE accounts.
- I've attached the remittance template and an example of the ledger auto-match file we expect. Please upload PO-BlueBay-2028-01.pdf to the HubSpot deal record when you have a moment — it expedites matching.

Next steps:
- Melanie / Arjun: confirm PO approach by Mon 25 Jul.
- Neha: finalize RB-Invoice-Governance-Schedule-v1 with Kimberly's VAT text and send final to BlueBay.
- I'll publish the ledger tag list and share the CSV spec for AP to ingest.

If you want, 15 minutes tomorrow to lock PO vs per-country routing. Otherwise I'll assume single PO unless you say otherwise.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations — Billing
Redwood Inference
